blocks.text: Fixed asset and lease accounting policy
HANGS General Contracting LP
Approved by: the partners, June 18, 2025
Owner: Dana Whitfield, Controller
Applies to: fiscal year 2026
Policy 1. Capitalization threshold. Equipment and improvements costing $5,000.00 or more with a useful life over one year are capitalized; smaller items are expensed.

Policy 2. Cost. Cost is the purchase price plus delivery, assembly, setup and training needed to put the asset in service. Repairs and maintenance that restore an existing asset, and do not add capacity or extend its life beyond the original estimate, are expensed to account 6200.

Policy 3. Depreciation. Straight-line over the class life below, a full month in the month the asset is placed in service, no salvage value. Depreciation stops when the asset is fully depreciated or disposed of.
Policy 5. Approval. A purchase over $25,000.00 needs a capital expenditure request approved and signed by a partner before the order is placed.
Policy 6. Useful lives. The Controller reviews useful lives each year end against the hours log; an asset still working past its class life is reported to the partners.
Policy 7. Impairment. Equipment that is idle for two quarters or more, damaged, or listed for sale is reported to the partners at year end for an impairment review.

Policy 8. Leases. Leases are accounted for under ASC 842. The short-term lease exemption is elected for every class of asset: a lease of 12 months or less, with no purchase option the partnership is reasonably certain to exercise, is expensed straight-line. Leases are discounted at the equipment term loan rate, 6.75%, as the incremental borrowing rate.
Policy 4. Class lives.
Class life: Heavy earthmoving and paving equipment: 84 months
Class life: Cranes and crane attachments: 120 months
Class life: Concrete pump trucks: 84 months
Class life: Trucks and trailers: 60 months
Class life: Site office units: 120 months
Class life: Loaders, telehandlers and skid steers: 60 months
Class life: Survey and layout equipment: 60 months
Class life: Buildings: 480 months
Demonstration document. Every name and figure is invented.
